messages:
Maggie: Heads up — product wants a single-pane dashboard for continuous batching signals we can hand to customers and SRE. Focus: batch size distribution, wait-time percentiles, and saturation indicators. Need cross-team input on what runtime can provide and how infra tags routing/pools.

Ethan: +1. Can we get per-route and per-model granularity? product wants to correlate small batch spikes with specific routing policies (latency vs cost).

Rachel: We can emit per-route/model labels but it increases metrics cardinality. Propose route+model on histograms only, and route-only on gauges. Also we already expose: `redwood_inflight_requests_total` and `redwood_batch_dispatch_duration_seconds`.

Tom: For infra, we can add pool tagging (pool_id, gpu_type, region). Important for saturation panels. We'll also expose per-pool capacity and allocated_slots_gauge.

Priya: UX request: show p50/p95/p99 for batch wait and batch size heatmap over time. Would be great to break down by routing_policy tag. Can DevEx produce a mock panel layout?

Sam: SRE needs alerts. Suggested signals: 1) queue_saturation > 0.9 for 2m; 2) p95 batch_wait > 200ms for 3m; 3) avg_batch_size drop > 30% vs rolling 1h baseline (possible regression).

Rachel: Sketch of new metrics we can add (Prometheus):

```
# Histogram of sizes we push at dispatch time
redwood_batch_size_bucket{route="",model="",le=""}  
redwood_batch_size_sum{}  
redwood_batch_size_count{}

# Histogram of time a request waits in queue until included in a batch
redwood_batch_wait_seconds_bucket{route="",model=""}  
redwood_batch_wait_seconds_sum{}  
redwood_batch_wait_seconds_count{}

# Gauge representing how full a pool is (0..1)
redwood_queue_saturation{pool="",region="",gpu_type=""}

# Gauge - number of in-flight batches per worker
redwood_inflight_batches{worker_id="",pool=""}

# Counter - times we evicted items from queue due to saturation
redwood_batch_evictions_total{pool="",reason=""}
``` 

Rachel: We'll also add a `routing_policy` label on batch histograms: `routing_policy="latency|cost|fallback"`. Warn: `routing_policy` *and* model+route increases cardinality a lot.

Ethan: To limit cardinality, can we restrict `routing_policy` on an opt-in basis per customer and expose `model` only for top-20 models? Or sample detailed labels for 1% of requests.

Tom: Sampling is doable in the agent that scrapes metrics, but complicates dashboards/alerts. Another option: expose the detailed label via a separate pushgateway metric that customers can opt into.

Priya: For the console UX, we should default to aggregated panels (all routes) and offer a dropdown to split by route/model/policy. That keeps the default cheap.

Maggie: Timeline: product wants a beta dashboard next sprint (2 weeks). We need owners for: metric implementation (runtime), infra tagging, dashboards (devex), alerts (SRE).

Rachel: I'll own runtime metric PRs. ETA: 7 days for histograms + saturation gauge. We'll add a feature flag to toggle `routing_policy` label.

Tom: I'll add pool labels and allocated_slots_gauge. ETA: 4 days.

Priya: I'll do a mock Grafana layout and a Console wireframe in 5 days. Will include example panels: heatmap batch_size, stacked area saturation by pool, line chart batch_wait p50/p95/p99, table of top routes by small-batch-rate.

Sam: I'll write alert rules once metrics land. Can we agree on initial thresholds: queue_saturation > 0.9(2m), batch_wait_seconds_p95 > 0.2s(3m), evictions_rate > 5/min? We can tune after canary.

Rachel: Quick implementation note: in code we'll record `enqueue_time` and `dispatch_time` and observe `dispatch_time - enqueue_time` into `redwood_batch_wait_seconds`. Also record `batch.size` before dispatch. Pseudocode: 

```
enqueue(req) -> req.enqueue_ts = now()
when dispatch(batch):
  for req in batch:
    observe(redwood_batch_wait_seconds, now() - req.enqueue_ts, labels={route,model,routing_policy})
  observe(redwood_batch_size, batch.size, labels={route,model,routing_policy})
```

Ethan: For rollout, let's feature-flag `routing_policy` label and run it in canary on dedicated test tenants first. Priya, make sure the console dropdown only shows detailed splits when the flag is enabled.

Maggie: Who's doing the canary?

Tom: infra can carve out `canary-pool-01`. We'll route ~2% traffic.

Priya: I'll add a note in the Console UX to hide model dropdown unless the tenant is in the opt-in list.

Maggie: OK owners confirmed: Rachel (runtime histograms) / Tom (pool labels) / Priya (dash + console) / Sam (alerts). Rachel and Tom — please open PRs and link here.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: infra/pool-labels -> canary-pool-01 on 1763500000.

Rachel: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/732 — adds histograms and feature flag.

Tom: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/289 — pool labels + allocated_slots gauge.

Priya: Mock dashboard: https://figma.internal/redwood/batch-dashboard — comments added. I'll pair with Ethan to wire the Grafana panels.

Sam: I'll draft alert rules and post for review by EOD tomorrow.

Maggie: Great. We'll review progress in the weekly telemetry sync. Thanks everyone :rocket:
